title: Mobius approval request (MASP 0.1)
description: What an approver (dialog, webhook, Slack bot, phone) receives. The approver answers {"decision": "approved" | "rejected" | "expired"}. Anything else, an error or silence counts as rejected.

summary.description: Built from device state (the real button text), never from the agent's words

reason.description: Why approval is needed (the rule that fired)
